regions.merged_text: Any photos or pictures of Fr. Solanus or the others I hardly know what I should do with them: so you may burn them if you wish. However I , would like to have the one of our golden jubilee that is framed viz. the one with all the little grandchildren. Some of them are grandparents now themselves. Well I guess I'd better come to a conclusion. Otherwise -- ?? Best regards to Br. Rufin and to all. Hope Br. Gerard is improving and that he'll get out of any further operation.
